scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.check: npm run docs:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.audit:all: npm audit --audit-level=moderate && npm --prefix server audit --audit-level=moderate && npm --prefix web audit --audit-level=moderate
